ops.prevDaySetup: For sending packages, arrange a delivery company so that they arrive within the reserved time (the hotel holds items from the day before the banquet). The reservation includes preparation time, which is discussed at the planning meeting.
ops.loadingHours: Load-in and load-out of decoration and entertainment equipment and materials by vendors the organizer has hired directly, as well as the size, mounting method and location of signs, follow certain rules that take the hotel's appearance and guest flow into account. Contact the hotel staff in advance (Banquet Reservations 03-5285-8962).
ops.parking: When cars are used for a banquet, parking fees are charged individually to everyone other than the representative (organizer) (banquet use: free for up to 4 hours, then 800 yen per hour). Guests are advised to use public transportation.
ops.catering: Boxed meals for meetings are available. Decoration, music, lighting, entertainment and receptionists are arranged by the hotel through designated vendors, and the hotel's prior approval is required to use anyone other than the designated vendors (Banquet and Event Terms, dated April 1, 2019).
ops.restaurants: The hotel has the Chinese restaurant Royal Ryuho (皇家龍鳳), the Kyoto cuisine restaurant Tankuma Kitamise (たん熊北店), the teppanyaki restaurant Miyabi (みや美), the dining restaurant Ferio, Garden Lounge and Cellar Bar. Private rooms (4-36 guests) and private hire are also available at the restaurants, and a banquet hall can be used in succession for a social gathering or after-party following training.
